title: The Decline of Non-Military Montepíos in Early Mexico: A Historical, Actuarial, and Financial Approach
abstract: This article investigates the decline of non-military Montepíos in early Mexico through historical, actuarial, and financial analysis. It relates institutional design and financial sustainability to contribution histories, pension commitments to survivors, and demographic and household patterns, including gender and marriage. The analysis uses these features to explain why the funds faced imbalances and to draw lessons about the design of social-protection institutions.
